title: Search Insert Position
summary: In a strictly increasing integer array, return the zero-based index of target.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–10000 distinct sorted entries in [−10000,10000]. target is in [−10000,10000]. The insertion position may equal the array length.
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned int.

statement: In a strictly increasing integer array, return the zero-based index of target. If it is absent, return the position where inserting it would keep the array increasing. Use logarithmic time.

examples.explanation: The target is already at index 1.
The new value belongs after the array.

constraints: 1–10000 distinct sorted entries in [−10000,10000]. target is in [−10000,10000]. The insertion position may equal the array length.
hints: Conceptual: The answer is the first position whose value is at least the target.
Directional: Maintain a half-open interval of possible insertion positions.
Implementation: If the middle value is below target, discard it and everything before it. Otherwise keep the left half including the middle boundary.
complexityAnalysis: O(log n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
